WITH T01 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT OPPOR.SALFCY_0 Site, OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 ProjectNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 PN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 ProjectDate FROM EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR WHERE 1=1
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH')
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
-- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE') AND (OPPOR.CREDAT_0 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateFrom} ,120) AND CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateTo} ,120)) ), T02 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT OPPOR.SALFCY_0 Site, OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 ProjectNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 PN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 ProjectDate FROM EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR WHERE 1=1
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH')
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
AND OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 != '' -- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE') AND (OPPOR.CREDAT_0 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateFrom} ,120) AND CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateTo} ,120)) ), T03 AS ( SELECT * FROM T01
UNION SELECT * FROM T02 ), T0 AS ( -- find project with seq SELECT PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 ORDER BY PORDERP.ROWID) AS SEQ FROM T03 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T03.ProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T03.Site = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 WHERE AND RIGHT(PORDERP.PJT_0, 4) != '0001' AND RIGHT(PORDERP.PJT_0, 8) != 'ZLOGISTIC' AND PORDERP.PJT_0 != 'TQUALITE' ---FACHDIV0001: PURCHASE VARIOUS ---FACHTRADRTD: INBOUND CUSTOM FEES ---FVENTRAAUT: OUTBOUND SHIPMENT FEES ---FACHTRAAUT: INBOUND SHIPMENT FEES AND PORDERP.ITMREF_0 NOT IN ('FACHDIV0001', 'FACHTRADRTD', 'FVENTRAAUT','FACHTRAAUT') ), T1 AS ( -- find project which has more than one seq SELECT DISTINCT T0.PRHFCY_0, T0.PJT_0, T0.ITMREF_0 FROM T0 WHERE T0.SEQ > 1 ), T2 AS ( -- find purchase line for sales order line SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0, PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0, PORDERP.CREDAT_0, PORDERP.CREDATTIM_0, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0, PORDERQ.LINATIAMT_0, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0, PORDERP.CREUSR_0, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 ORDER BY PORDERP.ROWID ) AS SEQ, SUM(PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0, PORDERP.PJT_0 ) AS PQTY, SORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS SQTY FROM T1 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T1.PJT_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T1.ITMREF_0 = PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AND T1.PRHFCY_0 = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON (SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 = T1.PJT_0 OR SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = T1.PJT_0) ), T3 AS ( -- find purchase line for stock project SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0, PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0, PORDERP.CREDAT_0, PORDERP.CREDATTIM_0, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0, PORDERQ.LINATIAMT_0, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0, PORDERP.CREUSR_0, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.PJT_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 ORDER BY PORDERP.ROWID ) AS SEQ, SUM(PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PRHFCY_0, PORDERP.ITMREF_0, PORDERP.PJT_0 ) AS PQTY, SUM(MFGITM.EXTQTY_0) OVER (PARTITION BY MFGITM.PJT_0 ) AS SQTY FROM T1 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T1.PJT_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T1.ITMREF_0 = PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AND T1.PRHFCY_0 = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.MFGITM MFGITM ON MFGITM.PJT_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND MFGITM.MFGFCY_0 = T1.PRHFCY_0 WHERE SUBSTRING(PORDERP.PJT_0,6,1) = '-' --- ProjectNO is not Sales projectno OR SUBSTRING(PORDERP.PJT_0,7,1) = '-' OR SUBSTRING(PORDERP.PJT_0,8,1) = '-' )
SELECT T2.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, T2.ITMREF_0 AS PN, T2.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, T2.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, T2.QTYSTU_0 AS PurchaseQty, T2.LINATIAMT_0 AS Cost, T2.NETCUR_0 AS Currency, T2.CREDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, T2.PQTY AS TotalPurchaseQty, T2.SQTY AS TotalSalesQty, T2.CREUSR_0 AS Purchaser, T2.SEQ AS Seq FROM T2 INNER JOIN T2 AS T4 ON T2.PJT_0 = T4.PJT_0 AND T2.ITMREF_0 = T4.ITMREF_0 WHERE T2.PQTY > T2.SQTY
UNION
SELECT T3.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, T3.ITMREF_0 AS PN, T3.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, T3.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, T3.QTYSTU_0 AS PurchaseQty, T3.LINATIAMT_0 AS Cost, T3.NETCUR_0 AS Currency, T3.CREDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, T3.PQTY AS TotalPurchaseQty, T3.SQTY AS TotalSalesQty, T3.CREUSR_0 AS Purchaser, T3.SEQ AS Seq FROM T3 INNER JOIN T3 AS T5 ON T3.PJT_0 = T5.PJT_0 AND T3.ITMREF_0 = T5.ITMREF_0 WHERE T3.PQTY > T3.SQTY
